car_lights.doc: features/city/view/city_headlights.gd: on these grades the max_cars cars nearest the focus within radius_m carry a headlight cone per lamps_m offset (car frame, metres, nose along +x) and police cars a siren at siren_m; held lights, moved once per sim tick. Day holds none.

doc: The 2D light model (core/render/README.md). A light is a pooled additive quad on the `light` canvas whose radial falloff is cut into `steps` flat bands with world-locked 45-degree hatching at each band edge, so it prints as paper (or an accent ink) over the charcoal streets, never as a soft 3D glow. token / alt_token are palette.json ids (alt: the strobe alternates on flicker_hz). cone_deg 0 = radial, else a cone along the light rotation. life_ticks 0 = held until removed (headlights, fire, sirens), else fades out over that many 60 Hz sim ticks. grades re-print the screen before the lights add (grade_ink.gdshader: luminance -> paper_level * l^gamma, hue kept, accent pixels keep accent_keep of their value; day = identity, the rect is hidden). max_lights is the per-frame budget: beyond it the oldest timed light is dropped.

grades.doc: the D4 baseline: no grading (the grade rect is hidden)

later acts: the same print re-inked darker and harder - paper prints at paper_level of its luminance, the mids and darks sink faster (gamma), hue kept (warm paper, warm charcoal); accent pixels keep most of their value so the spot colours stand out; lights cut paper back out of it

kinds.doc: a gun firing: a short paper fan along the barrel
a blast: paper core, the outer band on the vermilion plate (danger)
the police strobe: vermilion / paper (red and blue are off-doctrine; teal is the dead)
burning wreck or barrel: a flickering vermilion core
a street lamp's pool: a small paper disc under the head, two bands

prop_lights.doc: features/city/view/city_prop_lights.gd: on these grades the max_props light-carrying props nearest the focus within radius_m hold a `kind` light at their row's at_m (the prop sprite's frame, metres from its centre, +x along the sprite: the lamp head). Day holds none.
